property_summary: When an unapproved caller (non-owner) calls logCreated, the reference returns false, while the buggy version returns true; this test asserts that logCreated returns false for an unapproved caller.
change_summary: Replace `if (!approvedToLog(msg.sender)) return false;` with `if (!approvedToLog(msg.sender)) return true;` so that logCreated returns true even when caller is not approved.
